## Summary

MiTAC International is a Taiwanese electronics manufacturer established on 8 December 1982 in Hsinchu Science Park, described by Wikipedia as part of the MiTAC-Synnex Group [2]. MiTAC Holdings Corporation was established on 12 September 2013 through a 100% stock swap with MiTAC International Corp. and is listed on the Taiwan Stock Exchange; the group sells GPS navigation devices, automotive products, cloud services and TYAN x86 server platforms [3]. Wikipedia lists the Mio, Magellan and Navman navigation brands as MiTAC subsidiaries, records the 2007 merger with Tyan Computer for the server business, and says MiTAC does OEM server business for the top five server brands [2].

The IEEE registry gives MITAC INTERNATIONAL CORP. two MA-L blocks, 00-40-D0 and 00-22-4D, both at Taiwan addresses, the second in Taipei [1]; MAC Lookup dates 00-22-4D to October 2008 [4]. Which products used these blocks is not documented by any source consulted, so the device class is unknown, and the group brands listed under found_in are group products, not confirmed holders of these OUIs. Other MiTAC entities hold their own blocks under other names (MITAC COMPUTING TECHNOLOGY CORPORATION, Mitac Technology Corp) [1]. MiTAC's own site refused the fetch and the FCC ID databases were not reachable from this session, so radios, silicon and FCC grantee codes are not listed.
